findings.why_it_matters: Wrong heading level. Every other statement clause in Section VI is a level-2 heading (`## 6.20 THE MULTIPLY STATEMENT`, `## 6.21 THE PERFORM STATEMENT`); 6.22 is promoted to level 1, so it sits at the same level as the document's top headings and breaks the outline. The 6.23 SET heading on a later page shows the same promotion.

Wrong heading level. Sub-clauses 6.NN.N are level-3 headings elsewhere (`### 6.21.1 Function`, `### 6.21.2 General Format`), and 6.22.3 and 6.22.4 on page 355 are `###`; here 6.22.1 and 6.22.2 are `##`, which makes them siblings of 6.22 instead of its children, and puts them one level above their own siblings 6.22.3 and 6.22.4.
